title: Valorant Deathmatch Transfer Routine
author: hnA
summary: Deathmatch integrates mouse control with movement, crosshair placement, weapon recovery, angle isolation, peeking, and target awareness. Play each block with one explicit goal instead of chasing the lobby result.
progression: Default cycle: 8 deathmatches. Scale the volume to available time and recovery; consistent focused sessions are more useful than occasional marathons.
review_rule: After a death, identify one mechanical cause you could control. Do not turn every lost duel into an aim diagnosis; positioning and decision quality still matter.

blocks.title: Crosshair placement
blocks.goal: Keep the crosshair at head height and choose the correct distance from each corner for the expected peek.
rules: Do not spray; burst, reset, and take the next accurate burst.
Ignore kills and placement. Notice whether the crosshair began too low, too tight, or too wide.
Move the crosshair to the next plausible angle when an opponent has had time to reposition.

blocks.title: First-bullet accuracy I
blocks.goal: Acquire the head with one deliberate shot and respect the weapon's accuracy reset.
rules: Do not spam the head or body.
After a miss, wait until the Sheriff has visually settled before shooting again.

blocks.title: Movement and peeking
blocks.weapon: Rifle, burst or spray by situation
blocks.goal: Isolate one angle at a time and arrive ready to shoot rather than exposing yourself to several positions.
rules: Practise short swings, wide swings, jiggles, and wide crouch peeks deliberately.
After losing a duel, ask whether another peek style or an information jiggle fit the situation better.
When spraying fails, consider whether taking time to reset and burst would have won the duel.

blocks.title: First-bullet accuracy II
blocks.goal: Repeat the deliberate first-bullet block after movement practice and keep every shot fully accurate.
rules: Use one shot per complete accuracy reset.
Keep crosshair placement and clean movement from the earlier blocks.

blocks.title: Operator or weakest skill
blocks.weapon: Operator for regular users; otherwise repeat your weakest block
blocks.goal: With the Operator, seek active and difficult peeks instead of passively holding easy angles.
rules: Practise initiating fights and handling unexpected close or off-angle targets.
If the Operator is not relevant to your role, spend this match on the weakest earlier skill.
